terminal-fun

Terminal animations to watch and games to play while Claude Code works in another window. Stills captured from the real programs, in colour.

./wait-fun # random watch piece, switches every 90s
./wait-fun --until-done # cycle until Claude finishes, then a fireworks finale
./wait-fun watch [NAME] # one non-interactive piece
./wait-fun play [NAME] # one game
./wait-fun list # everything, with blurbs
./wait-fun credits # who inspired what
# wf is the short alias for wait-fun

Watch

biplane

A biplane tows a banner past drifting clouds and birds

inspired by sl by Toyoda Masashi

./wait-fun watch biplane

--text "hi"

blackhole

a glyph-shaded black hole with a swirling accretion disk

inspired by Raunak (@Skirook)

--tilt DEG --speed X --seed N

bonkyon

inspired by Bonkyon by Srijan Paul (injuly)

taken from Bonkyon sound assets via Srijan Paul (injuly), MIT

taken from 8bit blix (aka Lost Moons) by Questiion / Micah Young, CC BY 4.0, converted to AAC

taken from 8-bit Game Over by Euphrosyyn, CC BY 4.0

taken from button-04 by JarredGibb, CC0

taken from positive-beeps by themusicalnomad, CC0

taken from swosh-01 by qubodup, CC0

taken from Swosh 42 by qubodup, CC0

./wait-fun play bonkyon

--level N --endless --daily --seed N --solve

Controls arrows/WASD move, u undo, r restart, n/b next/previous level

typewriter

A desk typewriter: every key types in uneven ink; left alone it types art and verse

inspired by Typewriter FX Photo Filter by Brian Krause (Adducive)

inspired by adducive, "Typewriter art of an Olympia typewriter. Made with Typewriter FX" (Pinterest)

inspired by Flora Stacey, the typewritten butterfly (Pitman's Phonetic Journal, 1898)

inspired by Paul Smith (1921-2007), typewriter artist

verse taken from Percy Bysshe Shelley, "Ozymandias" (1818)

./wait-fun play typewriter

--auto --speed X --finish mint|olive|black|red --save FILE --seed N

Controls every key types; Enter return, Backspace back, Tab, up/down platen, Esc m mute, Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D quit

Shared

Keys in every piece: p pause, q quit, r restart (games and some pieces), Ctrl-C quit.

Environment: NO_COLOR=1 drops colour; CLAUDE_FUN_NO_FOCUS_PAUSE=1 keeps full speed when the window loses focus.
